capabilities: Apply conditional formatting to Bases tables and cards
Add colour pill badges and cell fills
Import and export rule sets as JSON
extras: Non-destructive: uses pure CSS classes, variables and ::before icons, never editing notes. Makes zero network requests; all rules stay local. README also cross-promotes the author's other plugins (Ad Recap, Traffic Recap, UTM Vault) and themes (Chili & Popcorn).
intentEvidence: Add spreadsheet-style conditional formatting, colour pill badges, row/card highlights and inline progress bars to Obsidian Bases
problem: Bases tables and cards have no built-in way to visually highlight or colour values, making them harder to scan.
summary: Conditional formatting plugin that adds colour badges, row highlights and inline progress bars to Bases tables and cards.
